purpose: Generalize the already-established V2.8.4 post-observation issuer-identity ratification pattern so genuinely prospective ELIGIBLE_AI_CORE filing observations blocked only by unresolved issuer identity can become complete prospective filing-events after an official identity binding is committed, without reclassification, backdating, or outcome access.

problem_elimination_pass.final_goal: Allow prospective shadow accumulation to continue across previously unseen issuers without requiring classification to be rerun or blocked observations to be manually reconstructed one by one.
hard_constraints: The original filing must have been genuinely observed prospectively after V2.8.4 activation.
The original classification must already be ELIGIBLE_AI_CORE and must not be recomputed or strengthened by identity evidence.
The original positive record must have been blocked only because issuer_legal_name/issuer_identity_basis were unresolved.
Issuer identity must be bound under evidence/V2.8.4_E_LAYER_ISSUER_IDENTITY_BINDING_CONTRACT.json using official authority.
Eligibility completeness time must be the later of the original authoritative observation time and the actual identity-binding commit time.
Effective signal date must use the existing V2.8.4 next-joint-A-share-trading-day rule strictly after eligibility completeness.
No observation time, identity-binding time, eligibility-completeness time or effective date may be backdated.
announcement_id remains the filing-event identity and existing shadow dedup/conflict rules remain authoritative.
No price, return, benchmark, D5/D10, fold3/fold4, Setup, First60, Episode, live or brokerage data/action may be accessed.
problem_elimination_pass.soft_constraint_removed: Only effective_positive_events emitted during the first finalization pass can ever enter prospective shadow accumulation.
problem_elimination_pass.replacement: A blocked prospective positive may be ratified later when its sole missing static issuer identity becomes authoritative; the immutable original observation/finalization remain unchanged and the ratification supplies only the missing provenance plus the later causal completeness time.

temporal_rule.effective_signal_date: first frozen joint A-share trading day strictly after eligibility_completeness_time in Asia/Shanghai
